title: Creating a site from an existing workspace keeps the ready screen until the new workspace is opened
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/e2e/add-site-wizard.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and verify the test named in run.tests.
expect: The add-site wizard started from an existing site stays on that site after the new site's agent is ready.
The Open the workspace button remains visible and clicking it navigates to the new site's workspace.
The /new/ flow keeps its existing automatic navigation behavior.

selectors.completion: button accessible name Open the workspace

fence: Automatic ready-state navigation does not take over an existing site's workspace; explicit workspace navigation remains available. The /new/ route is unchanged.

tests: creating from an existing site keeps the ready screen until the new workspace is opened
